title: Refresh and verify my Neural Map: three aspects, twelve layouts, ten 3D views, and my development cycle
why: V2 (my architecture) is generated from my own source, so it must be regenerated when a src/core directory is added or removed. The whole multiverse (V1 knowledge, V2 architecture, V3 society) must still draw every node it derives in every layout, and saved views must survive a reload. It needs Playwright's Chromium and the dev server on 5173 (or LELU_BASE); it spends nothing.

steps.title: Regenerate V2's evidence from the source
steps.why: Writes src/core/neural/multiverse/cognitiveArchitecture.generated.json: subsystems with measured size, and real import edges. A new directory lands in 'unclassified' until FUNCTION_OF in the script files it.

steps.title: Every aspect in every layout, saved views, iPhone
Awareness, diagnosis, proposals, governance, research
steps.why: Proves my self-state names the view on screen, runs one bounded development cycle, checks the Architect's acknowledgment and owner decisions, and runs one real repository search. Writes docs/missions/neural-multiverse/verify-development.json.

steps.title: Re-check the 50 visual references
steps.why: Requests every source page and image and records status, type, hash and licence evidence. Run with python3 -I in an empty work directory, then build_atlas.py. Only images whose publisher licenses reuse may be embedded.

steps.title: Look at the screenshots
steps.why: The verifier proves every node is drawn; only eyes prove a layout reads as itself. Check that labels do not pile up and that the 'Not shown' panel is still honest about what each aspect cannot show.
